raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
On gfx1250:
- decode/prefill bf16 `wo_a` use the AITER bf16 GEMM
- fp32 compressor projections and the generic bf16/fp32 GEMM go through AITER `tgemm`
- the shared-expert `down_proj` and both `wq_b` GEMMs take their input quantized once for the `mxfp8_128` GEMM

Depends on sgl-project/sglang#48064.

<!-- results -->
### Accuracy
GSM8K (200 questions, greedy), DeepSeek-V4-Pro: TP4 0.960.

### Performance
Setup:
- Model: DeepSeek-V4-Pro, BF16 KV cache, DSPARK speculative decoding (block 6, 1 step)
- Parallelism: TP4 (`--tp 4`, CP prefill + CP decode attention)
- Step time: torch profiler on rank 0, GPU time per step; decode = 8 steps at 4 running requests (VERIFY = target verify, DRAFT = DSPARK draft), prefill = one EXTEND step of an ~8k-token prompt (TP4) / 4k (EP4)
- Comparison: with vs without this PR, same image and node, all earlier PRs of the series applied

Profiler step time (without -> with):

| step | without | with | change |
|---|---|---|---|
| decode VERIFY | 17.77 ms | 16.97 ms | -4.5% |
| decode DRAFT | 1.83 ms | 1.86 ms | +1.4% |
| prefill EXTEND | 191.9 ms | 191.1 ms | -0.4% |

Serving (`python -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random --random-range-ratio 1`, fresh random prompts):

| input/output, concurrency, prompts | output tok/s | mean TTFT (ms) | mean TPOT (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 32k/1k, C4, 32 | 584.4 -> 611.8 (+4.7%) | 2587 -> 2478 (-4.2%) | 4.16 -> 3.97 (-4.6%) |
| 1k/1k, C1, 32 | 355.8 -> 399.2 (+12.2%) | 180.7 -> 173.3 (-4.1%) | 2.64 -> 2.34 (-11.4%) |
| 1k/1k, C4, 96 | 1137.7 -> 1204.3 (+5.9%) | 326.8 -> 312.0 (-4.5%) | 3.16 -> 2.98 (-5.7%) |
<!-- /results -->

+def gfx1250_mxfp8_prepare_weight(
+    weight: torch.Tensor, weight_scale: torch.Tensor, block_size: List[int]
+) -> Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]:
+    if list(block_size) != [128, 128] or weight.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn:
+        return None
+    n, k = weight.shape
+    if n % 16 or k % 128 or weight_scale.dtype != torch.float32:
+        return None
+    mantissa, exponent = torch.frexp(weight_scale)
+    if not bool((mantissa == 0.5).all()):
+        return None
+    scale = (exponent - 1 + 127).clamp(0, 254).to(torch.uint8)
+    return aiter_shuffle_weight(weight, (16, 16)), scale.view(aiter_dtypes.fp8_e8m0)

+            )
+        wq_b.assert_not_called()
+
+        def fused(hidden_states, weight, eps, **kwargs):
+            self.assertIs(hidden_states, q_lora)
+            self.assertIs(weight, q_norm.weight)
+            self.assertEqual(eps, q_norm.variance_epsilon)
+            return "quant", "normalized", None, None
+
+        with (
+            patch.object(deepseek_v4, "_fused_rms_fp8_group_quant", fused),
+            patch.object(deepseek_v4, "_use_aiter_bpreshuffle_gfx95", False),
+        ):
+            self.assertEqual(
+                deepseek_v4._fused_q_lora_projection(q_lora, q_norm, wq_b),
+                ("q", "normalized", "quant"),
+            )
+        wq_b.assert_called_once_with("quant")
+
+    def test_forward_paths_share_capability_dispatch(self):
+        for method in (
+            deepseek_v4.MQALayer._forward_prepare_multi_stream_hip,
+            deepseek_v4.MQALayer._forward_prepare,
+        ):
+            source = inspect.getsource(method)
+            self.assertEqual(source.count("_fused_q_lora_projection("), 1)
+            self.assertNotIn("_is_gfx95_supported", source)
+            self.assertNotIn("_is_gfx1250_supported", source)
+
+

     def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
